name: GET /api/vault/byok/binding - This tenant's CMK binding and its rotations
description: Tenant route (Bearer JWT): the tenant comes from the token, and only that tenant's binding and keys are ever touched. The tenant portal used to drive BYOK through the /admin routes with the platform ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN for a tenant fixed in its environment (TK-4184). 200 { data: { binding, rotations[] (newest first: previous and new tenant key, started/completed) } }. Errors: no binding 404; no token 401.

testCases.name: Read the binding with its rotations

errorCases.message: no CMK is bound for this tenant
